text: The differential sweep is untracked: tmp-claude/2026-11-02-refactor-survey/alphabet/sweep.sh <sufr binary> <outdir>, run from the repo root, makes 7,376 CLI runs over every fixture, mode and flag; diff -rq two outdirs, ignoring .err files, whose only differences are panic line numbers and the binary's name. A before binary is built in a git worktree of the old commit. The benchmark suite is in benchmark-suite-location.
